en_title: Former Xbox COO Helen Chiang Speaks Out Following Shock Exit From Microsoft
cn_title: 前XBOX首席运营官Helen Chiang在令人震惊地离开Microsoft后发声
opus_summary: 前XBOX首席运营官Helen Chiang就离开Microsoft的传闻发声，否认泄密、加入竞争对手及其他不当行为的指控。她表示，围绕其离职的议论并不准确，并对相关标准在自己事件中的适用方式提出严重关切。

paragraphs.en: On November 2, former Xbox COO Helen Chiang took to LinkedIn to “set the record straight” about rumors over her exit from Microsoft.
paragraphs.cn: 11月2日，前XBOX首席运营官Helen Chiang在LinkedIn发文，就有关她离开Microsoft的传言「澄清事实」。

paragraphs.en: Chiang, who was promoted as Xbox’s first-ever chief operating officer in July, had been with the company for 21 years, previously serving as the head of Minecraft. Her exit from the role in late October — just three months after the position was created — came as a shock to both industry veterans and fans alike.
paragraphs.cn: Chiang于7月获晋升，成为XBOX有史以来首位首席运营官。她已在公司任职21年，此前曾担任Minecraft负责人。她在10月下旬离开这一职位——距离该职位设立仅三个月——令业内资深人士和粉丝都感到震惊。

paragraphs.en: In her post, Chiang said rumors of this supposed policy violation were “not accurate,” and claimed that the discourse surrounding her departure from Xbox has “created a picture of me that I hardly recognize.”
paragraphs.cn: Chiang在帖子中表示，有关这项所谓违反政策行为的传言「并不准确」，并称围绕她离开XBOX的讨论「塑造了一个让我自己都几乎认不出的形象」。

paragraphs.en: She strongly denied accusations of “leaking confidential company information to the press,” saying she’s never spoken to journalists outside of interviews approved by Xbox. She also denied rumors that she left the company to join a competitor, and pushed back on allegations of “engaging in discrimination, bullying, harassment, insider trading, embezzlement, or other fraudulent activity,” or leaving because she was “passed over for a bigger role.”
paragraphs.cn: 她强烈否认了「向媒体泄露公司机密信息」的指控，表示除了XBOX批准的采访之外，她从未与记者交谈过。她还否认了自己离开公司是为了加入竞争对手的传言，并驳斥了她「从事歧视、霸凌、骚扰、内幕交易、侵占或其他欺诈活动」，或因「未能获得更高职位」而离职的说法。

paragraphs.en: “I stand by my record: both the results I delivered and the way I have treated people throughout my career. I won’t let speculation define my character or erase that record,” she wrote.
paragraphs.cn: 她写道：「我坚持维护自己的过往表现：包括我取得的成果，以及我在整个职业生涯中待人的方式。我不会让猜测定义我的品格或抹去这些记录。」

paragraphs.en: “I believe in fairness, accountability, and holding ourselves to the standards we expect of others. Those standards only mean something when they’re applied consistently. I have serious concerns about how they were applied in my case, and I believe those concerns deserve to be taken seriously.
paragraphs.cn: 「我相信公平、问责，以及用我们要求他人的标准来要求自己。只有一以贯之地执行，这些标准才有意义。我对这些标准在我身上如何执行有严重疑虑，我认为这些疑虑值得被认真对待。

paragraphs.en: “I share this because I don’t want my departure reduced to an inaccurate story about incompetence, ambition for the next big job, or a Nelson-level scandal. My story is about staying true to your core values, especially when it is hard. That’s the legacy I hope to leave behind.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我说这些，是因为我不想让自己的离开被简化为一个关于能力不足、觊觎下一个重要职位，或Nelson级别丑闻的失实故事。我的故事关乎忠于自己的核心价值观，尤其是在这样做很艰难的时候。这是我希望留下的精神遗产。」

paragraphs.en: She ended her post by saying that this was “not how I ever imagined my story here would end,” saying, “it is not the whole story.”
paragraphs.cn: 她在帖子的结尾表示，这「不是我曾想象过的自己在这里的故事会迎来的结局」，并说：「这不是故事的全部。」

paragraphs.en: IGN has asked Microsoft for comment.

Chiang's exit was confirmed by an internal memo obtained by The Verge on October 23. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma mentioned the news in a brief statement within the memo, writing: “Helen Chiang is leaving Microsoft today. I’m grateful for her years of service and wish her well. We’ll share more on COO leadership as plans are finalized.”
paragraphs.cn: The Verge于10月23日获得的一份内部备忘录证实了Chiang离职的消息。XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma在备忘录中的一份简短声明里提到了这一消息，写道：「Helen Chiang今天将离开Microsoft。我感谢她多年来的付出，并祝愿她一切顺利。待计划敲定后，我们将分享更多有关首席运营官领导安排的信息。」

paragraphs.en: Chiang's promotion was announced amid the news of Xbox's massive restructuring in the summer. In a statement, Sharma praised Chiang for her tenure at the company, saying, “Over nearly two decades at Xbox, Helen has helped build some of our most important businesses, from Xbox Live to leading Mojang and the Minecraft franchise. She will bring our businesses together under one operating model, making sure we make clear investment decisions, learn from our successes and failures, and hold ourselves accountable for results.”
paragraphs.cn: Chiang获得晋升的消息是在今夏XBOX大规模重组的消息传出之际宣布的。Sharma在一份声明中称赞了Chiang在公司任职期间的表现，表示：「在XBOX工作的近20年里，Helen帮助建立了我们一些最重要的业务，从XBOX Live到领导Mojang和Minecraft系列。她将把我们的业务整合到一个运营模式之下，确保我们做出明确的投资决策，从成功和失败中吸取经验，并对结果负责。」
